summary: Fixed a race condition in AgentStore where switching threads during streaming could let stale resumeSession responses or event streams overwrite the newly selected thread. Introduced a private #selectionVersion counter incremented on switchSession, and gated sessionId mismatches/version checks in resumeSession and message-loading cleanup so older requests are ignored.
decisions: Added #selectionVersion counter on AgentStore incremented in switchSession to detect stale async responses.
resumeSession rejects its result when sessionId or selectionVersion no longer matches the captured values, preventing stale thread loads from overwriting the active thread.
messagesLoading cleanup is only cleared when both sessionId and selectionVersion still match, so stale requests can't flip loading state on the current thread.
Existing event filter `if (this.sessionId && event.sessionId !== this.sessionId) return;` already guards stream events against cross-session application.
